summary: Oman lets GCC nationals enter freely and waives visas for stays of up to 14 days for 78 nationalities, including the EU, US, UK and Canada, and for 24 more whose citizens live in or hold a visa for the US, Canada, Australia, the UK, a Schengen country or Japan, while the Royal Oman Police eVisa covers longer tourist stays; the Foreign Ministry says other nationalities can find their visa options on the Royal Oman Police eVisa website.

conditionalWaivers.text: Residents of another GCC state can apply for Oman's GCC-resident eVisa (four weeks, extendable by one week) instead of a sponsored visa. The Royal Oman Police grants it only to residents whose professions it specifies.

source.name: Royal Oman Police eVisa — visa types (Visit Unsponsored visas: GCC Resident Visa, type 29)

conditionalWaivers.text: Citizens of the Foreign Ministry's second group of countries (among them India, Egypt, Morocco, Mexico and Vietnam) can enter Oman visa-free for up to 14 days if they live in, or hold a valid visa for, the United States, Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom, a Schengen country or Japan, or live in a GCC country in a profession eligible for the resident visa. The stay cannot be extended, and a return ticket, hotel booking, health insurance and enough funds are required.

source.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Oman — Entry visas (14-day visa exemption, first and second groups)

passportValidity.text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months from the date of arrival in Oman.

source.name: Frequently Asked Questions - Evisa

vaccinations.name: Yellow fever
vaccinations.certificate: International Certificate of Vaccination or Prophylaxis (ICVP)
vaccinations.text: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required from travelers aged nine months and over arriving from a country with risk of yellow fever transmission, and a transit of more than 12 hours through such a country's airport counts. Oman applies its own list of origin countries rather than WHO's risk list.

source.name: WHO, International Travel and Health, Annex 1 — countries requiring proof of vaccination against yellow fever
source.instrument: International Health Regulations (2005), Article 36 and Annex 7; WHO International Travel and Health, Annex 1, 18 November 2022 (revised 3 January 2023)

travelInsurance.text: Visa-free visitors must be able to show proof of travel health insurance at the border, along with a return or onward ticket and proof of accommodation such as a hotel booking.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — Oman travel advice: entry requirements

alsoStatedOn.name: Foreign Ministry of Oman — Entry visas, full text of the regulations: return ticket, confirmed hotel reservation, health insurance and funds for visa-free entry

onwardTicket.text: The Royal Oman Police eVisa conditions require holders of the 30-day tourist eVisa (26B), the New Zealand 3-month eVisa (26C) and the 30-day eVisa for South Korea, Brunei, Kazakhstan, Russia and Turkey (26D) to have a return ticket and a valid hotel booking in Oman. The UK Foreign Office says visa-free visitors must also be able to show a return or onward ticket and proof of accommodation at the border.

source.name: Royal Oman Police eVisa — visa-type details (Tourist Visit Visa 26B, 26C, 26D: entry conditions)

proofOfFunds.text: Visa-free visitors must carry enough money to cover their living costs during the stay. No official source we could read states a fixed amount.

source.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Oman — Entry visas

currencyLimits.text: Cash, bearer securities, precious metals or gemstones worth OMR 6,000 or more (or the foreign-currency equivalent) must be declared to customs on arrival and on departure, on the money-laundering declaration form.

source.name: Oman Customs (Royal Oman Police) — traveller services
source.instrument: Law on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing, Article 53

notes: The UK FCDO says it is illegal to fly drones without a valid licence or in restricted airspace, and the Government of Canada says you must get authorization before importing or operating a drone.

The UK FCDO says it is illegal to import or use e-cigarettes or vape products in Oman, and that some UK prescription and over-the-counter medicines are illegal there — carry a copy of your prescription.

safety.text: The Government of Canada advises avoiding non-essential travel to Oman because of the volatile security situation in the region. The UK FCDO reports strikes and retaliatory attacks by Iran in a number of locations across the region, including Oman, since 8 July 2026, and warns of flight cancellations and periodic airspace closures. It says personal attacks on foreign nationals are relatively rare but happen, that photographing some government buildings and military sites is illegal, and that wadis are prone to flash flooding after heavy rain from October to March.

source.name: UK FCDO — Oman travel advice

alsoStatedOn.name: Government of Canada — Oman travel advice (risk level)

source.name: IEC World Plugs (International Electrotechnical Commission) — plug types, voltage and frequency by location

bestTimeToVisit.text: No official seasonal guidance. The UK FCDO says wadis are prone to flash flooding after heavy rain from October to March, that tropical cyclones sometimes affect Oman in July and August, and that extreme heat has caused deaths.

tips.text: The Foreign Ministry says the 14-day visa-free entry requires a return ticket, a confirmed hotel booking, health insurance and enough money for the stay, and cannot be extended. For longer trips, apply for a visa on the Royal Oman Police eVisa website before travel.

The UK FCDO says wadis (dry riverbeds) are prone to flash flooding after heavy rain from October to March. Check the forecast before visiting a wadi and avoid places where heavy rain is expected, and for at least one day afterwards.

The UK FCDO says road trips to the desert and mountains can be dangerous unless you are in a well-equipped four-wheel-drive vehicle; travel in convoy if possible, carry water and a phone, and leave your plans with someone.
The UK FCDO says to dress modestly in public areas, including malls, with the tops of arms and legs (below the knee) covered, and not to wear swimwear in public except on tourist beaches or at pools.

The UK FCDO says visitors can buy and drink alcohol only in licensed venues such as hotels, restaurants and clubs (legal age 21). Drinking or being drunk in public and drink-driving are illegal, and any alcohol found in a driver's system can bring a fine and possible imprisonment.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Oman?
faq.answer: GCC citizens do not need a visa. 78 nationalities — including the EU, UK, US, Canada, Australia, Japan and China — can enter visa-free for up to 14 days with a return ticket, a confirmed hotel booking, health insurance and enough money for the stay; 24 more can if they live in or hold a visa for the US, Canada, Australia, the UK, a Schengen country or Japan. For longer tourist stays the Royal Oman Police issues an unsponsored 30-day eVisa. The Foreign Ministry says other nationalities can find their visa options on the Royal Oman Police eVisa website.

faq.question: How does Oman's 14-day visa-free entry work?
faq.answer: The Foreign Ministry admits eligible nationalities without a visa for stays of up to 14 days, which cannot be extended or turned into a residence visa. The visitor needs a passport valid for at least six months, a return ticket, a confirmed hotel booking, health insurance and enough money for the stay. For anything longer, apply for a visa on the Royal Oman Police eVisa website (evisa.rop.gov.om).

faq.question: How much does the Oman eVisa cost?
faq.answer: The Royal Oman Police eVisa website lists an unsponsored tourist eVisa for a 10-day or a 30-day visit (the stay can be extended by the same length, the first time online). The Royal Oman Police lists the fee as OMR 5 for the 10-day eVisa (26A) and OMR 20 for the 30-day eVisa (26B). Apply through the Royal Oman Police eVisa website (evisa.rop.gov.om).

faq.question: Can Israeli citizens visit Oman?
faq.answer: No official source we could read states whether Oman admits travellers on Israeli passports.

faq.question: When is the best time to visit Oman?
faq.answer: No official source names a best time to visit. The UK FCDO says wadis are prone to flash flooding after heavy rain from October to March, tropical cyclones sometimes affect Oman in July and August, and extreme heat has caused deaths from dehydration and heat exhaustion.
